title: Reconcile deposits, fees and timing
prompt: Build a document-only workflow for an uploaded Excel bank/ledger reconciliation in USD. Use no external apps. Match by reference and amount; match processor batches many-to-one using gross receipts less documented fees. Flag exact duplicate ledger IDs, keep uncleared ledger items as timing differences and unexplained bank items as exceptions. Provide a reconciled cash bridge, proposed fee/unknown-item entries for review, and source-row evidence. Do not book entries or send messages. Generated tests should verify numeric reconciliation.
expected: Raw bank movement 795. Raw ledger movement 280. Remove duplicate J3 to get ledger 780. Add back uncleared CHECK-OPEN 120, subtract fee 30, subtract unexplained bank debit 75: 780+120-30-75=795. B1 matches J1+J2 less fee. UNKNOWN requires investigation, not invented classification. J5 is timing, not an error.

title: Cash runway with delayed collections
prompt: Build a document-only workflow that reads an uploaded Excel four-week cash plan and produces base and downside cash forecasts in USD. Use no external apps. Opening cash is 5000 and the minimum operating buffer is 2000. Base case collects the stated receivables in their scheduled weeks. Downside collects only 50% of the week-2 receivable in week 2 and moves the remainder to week 4; other receipts and payments stay unchanged. Show opening cash, receipts, payments, closing cash and buffer deficit for every week in both cases. Identify the first shortfall and peak financing need, and propose options for human review without executing anything. Tests should assert numeric balances and cash conservation.
expected: Base closing cash weeks 1–4: 3500,3000,2000,2500. Downside closing: 3500,1000,0,2500. First buffer breach week 2; maximum funding need versus 2000 buffer is 2000 in week 3. Base never falls below buffer (equals in week 3). Total receipts 9000, payments 11500, ending cash 2500 in both scenarios. Downside week-4 receipts 5000.
